text:
tom: Need quick help - AcmeRetail POC using our typescript SDK (node 18) behind corporate proxy. After ~20m their demo worker spins up many node processes and we hit EMFILE. Anyone seen agent/socket leaks with streaming?

nina-sales: Customer panic mode, demo Friday. CC @li-eng @ben-sdks.

li-eng: Do they use fetch or the axios/http client? Any client config to share?

tom: They use our SDK which uses node-fetch + http(s).Agent by default. Snippet they run: 

```js
const agent = undefined; // default agent from sdk
const res = await sdk.chat.stream({ messages }, { signal });
for await (const chunk of res) {
  render(chunk);
}
```

Logs: 
```
2026-03-21T08:10:05Z ERROR node: EMFILE: too many open files
2026-03-21T08:10:05Z WARN client: proxy 503 during CONNECT
2026-03-21T08:10:06Z INFO worker: resp closed unexpectedly
```

ben-sdks: Proxy 503 during CONNECT + EMFILE usually means the Agent kept sockets in the pool when the proxy failed the tunnel handshake. Node's Agent will keep sockets alive unless destroyed. If the SDK doesn't destroy the socket on early non-2xx, the fd count climbs.

li-eng: Short-term mitigation we can ask customer to apply before the demo?

ben-sdks: Quick options: 1) launch node with --max-old-space-size (mitigates OOM only) but not FD. Best immediate: pass a custom agent: new https.Agent({ keepAlive: false }) so each request tears down sockets. 2) Set environment to use direct egress to bypass proxy for demo. 3) Patch sdk to call res.body.cancel() and agent.destroy() on non-2xx/connect errors.

tom: One-liner I can ask them to apply now?

ben-sdks: Tell them: in process startup set: 
```js
const agent = new https.Agent({ keepAlive: false });
SDK.init({ agent });
```
That stops socket reuse and should prevent fd leaks for demo traffic.

ops-oncall: Heads-up: that increases connection churn. For demo it's fine, but not production. We'll monitor FD metrics after change.

ci-bot: branch fix/ts-sdk-proxy-leak created, PR #842 opened by ben-sdks.

tom: Thanks — I'll send the short agent snippet to AcmeRetail and apply monitor. Please ping me when PR merges.

ben-sdks: We'll land a defensive fix to cancel streams and destroy underlying sockets on proxy handshake failures in 0.9.5. RC planned tonight.

tom: Great, closing loop with customer now.
